import Std.Bytes.{Bytes}

const PNG_SIGNATURE = Bytes.hex("89504e47")

type Packet(id: Int, payload: Bytes)
  derive Eq

pub fn main() {
  data = Bytes.append(PNG_SIGNATURE, Bytes.encode_utf8("hi"))
  dbg(Bytes.size(data))
  dbg(Bytes.get(data, 0))
  dbg(Bytes.get(data, 5))
  dbg(Bytes.get(data, 6))
  dbg(Bytes.get(data, -1))
  dbg(Bytes.to_hex(data))
  dbg(Bytes.to_list(data))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.slice(data, 4, 6)))
  dbg(Bytes.is_empty(Bytes.empty()))
  dbg(Bytes.is_empty(data))

  # slice clamps both ends and is empty when `from` is not less than `to`
  dbg(Bytes.slice(data, -3, 2))
  dbg(Bytes.slice(data, 4, 100))
  dbg(Bytes.slice(data, 4, 2))
  dbg(Bytes.slice(data, 7, 9))

  # from_list keeps each byte in 0 to 255
  dbg(Bytes.from_list([0, 127, 128, 255]))
  dbg(Bytes.from_list([256]))
  dbg(Bytes.from_list([-1]))
  dbg(Bytes.from_list([]))

  # hexadecimal
  dbg(Bytes.from_hex("DEADbeef"))
  dbg(Bytes.from_hex(""))
  dbg(Bytes.from_hex("abc"))
  dbg(Bytes.from_hex("zz"))
  dbg(Bytes.from_hex("ab cd"))
  small = Bytes.from_list([0, 1, 15, 16, 171]) |> Option.or(Bytes.empty())
  dbg(Bytes.to_hex(small))

  # concat joins all the parts in order
  dbg(Bytes.concat([Bytes.hex("01"), Bytes.empty(), Bytes.hex("0203")]))
  dbg(Bytes.concat([]))

  # UTF-8
  text = "é👍\u{FEFF}"
  encoded = Bytes.encode_utf8(text)
  dbg(encoded)
  assert Bytes.size(encoded) == String.byte_size(text)
  assert Bytes.decode_utf8(encoded) == Some(text)
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("efbbbf41")) |> Option.map(String.code_points))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("ff")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("c0af")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("e08080")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("eda080")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("f4908080")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("e282")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("80")))
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(Bytes.hex("f09f918d")))

  # Eq, Ord and Show
  assert Some(Bytes.hex("0102")) == Bytes.from_list([1, 2])
  assert Bytes.hex("0102") != Bytes.hex("01")
  dbg(Ord.compare(Bytes.hex("01"), Bytes.hex("0102")))
  dbg(Ord.compare(Bytes.hex("02"), Bytes.hex("0102")))
  dbg(Ord.compare(Bytes.hex("ff"), Bytes.hex("00")))
  dbg(Ord.compare(Bytes.hex("0102"), Bytes.hex("0102")))
  dbg(Ord.compare(Bytes.empty(), Bytes.empty()))
  dbg("#{PNG_SIGNATURE}")
  dbg(inspect(Bytes.empty()))
  dbg([Bytes.hex("00")])
  packet = Packet(id: 1, payload: Bytes.hex("cafe"))
  dbg(packet)
  assert packet == Packet(id: 1, payload: Bytes.hex("CAFE"))

  # a long sequence goes through loops, not deep recursion
  long = Bytes.concat(List.map(List.range(0, 128), fn(_) { Bytes.hex("ab") }))
  dbg(Bytes.size(long))
  assert long == Bytes.concat([long])
  round_trip = Bytes.from_hex(Bytes.to_hex(long)) |> Option.or(Bytes.empty())
  assert round_trip == long
  dbg(Bytes.decode_utf8(long))
}

  changed = Map.insert(old, 2, n + 20) |> Map.insert(4, n + 4)
  assert(Map.size(old) == 3)
  assert(Map.get(old, 2) == Some(n + 2))
  assert(Map.get(changed, 2) == Some(n + 20))
  assert(Map.keys(changed) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  updated = Map.update(changed, 3, fn(value) { Option.map(value, fn(x) { x + 10 }) })
  removed = Map.remove(updated, 1)
  assert(!Map.contains(removed, 1))
  assert(Map.size(removed) == 3)
  filtered = Map.filter(removed, fn(key, _) { key % 2 == 0 })
  mapped = Map.map_values(filtered, fn(x) { x + 1 })
  assert(Map.to_list(mapped) == [(2, n + 21), (4, n + 5)])
  merged = Map.union(mapped, Map.from_list([(5, n + 5)]))
  assert(Map.keys(merged) == [2, 4, 5])
  assert(merged == Map.from_list([(5, n + 5), (4, n + 5), (2, n + 21)]))

  original = Set.from_list([3, 1, 2, 1])
  adjusted = Set.remove(original, 1) |> Set.insert(4)
  assert(Set.to_list(original) == [1, 2, 3])
  assert(Set.to_list(adjusted) == [2, 3, 4])
  united = Set.union(adjusted, Set.from_list([1, 4]))
  assert(united == Set.from_list([1, 2, 3, 4]))
  assert(Set.to_list(Set.filter(united, fn(x) { x % 2 == 0 })) == [2, 4])
  custom = Map.empty() |> Map.insert(Key(value: 11), n) |> Map.insert(Key(value: 21), n + 1)
  assert(Map.size(custom) == 1)
  assert(Map.get(custom, Key(value: 1)) == Some(n + 1))
  sorted = List.sort([Key(value: 3), Key(value: 12), Key(value: 1)])
  assert(List.map(sorted, fn(Key(value:)) { value }) == [1, 12, 3])
  Map.fold(merged, from: 0, f: fn(acc, _, value) { acc + value })
    + Set.fold(united, from: 0, f: fn(acc, value) { acc + value })
}

pub fn rotations(n: Int) -> Int {
  ascending = List.range(0, 24)
  descending = List.reverse(ascending)
  tree = List.fold(ascending, from: Map.empty(), f: fn(m, key) { Map.insert(m, key, n + key) })
  reverse_tree = List.fold(descending, from: Map.empty(), f: fn(m, key) { Map.insert(m, key, n + key) })
  assert(tree == reverse_tree)
  trimmed = List.fold(List.range(0, 12), from: tree, f: fn(m, key) { Map.remove(m, key) })
  assert(Map.keys(trimmed) == List.range(12, 24))
  assert(Map.size(tree) == 24)
  assert(Map.size(trimmed) == 12)
  Map.fold(trimmed, from: 0, f: fn(acc, key, value) { acc + value - key })
}
